opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition‑fee support, must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree (full‑time, part‑time or distance) for academic year 2026‑27, and meet residency and income thresholds.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover the cost of tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland, up to £1,820 per year, to help those who cannot afford tuition and are ineligible for government support.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Vacation Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled in an undergraduate degree (3rd year of a 4‑year degree, 3rd/4th year of a 5‑year degree, or 2nd year of a 3‑year degree), not previously awarded a Vacation Scholarship, and able to work in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Provides a stipend based on the Scottish Living Wage to support low‑income undergraduate students undertaking a 4‑12‑week summer research project, covering living and accommodation costs.
